svg.metadata: {"id": "s033", "name": "积木几何台", "cat": "数学", "tags": ["数学", "几何", "立体图形", "空间"], "desc": "明亮的积木角：墙上平面图形挂板，书架与桌上摆着正方体、长方体、圆柱、圆锥、球、棱锥和三棱柱，还有积木城堡。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [580, 1340]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "shape_board", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "shelf", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "table", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "castle", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor_blocks", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.85, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "plant", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "floating", "enter": "pop", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "bob", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#FFF4DA", "wall2": "#FBE3B9", "pat": "#F6D9A4", "shelf": "#E7B479", "shelf2": "#C98F55", "mat1": "#F7B7A3", "mat2": "#A8DCC9", "mat3": "#FFE08A", "mat4": "#B9C8F2", "r1": "#F27C66", "r2": "#F7A593", "r3": "#D45E4B", "b1": "#5FA8E0", "b2": "#93C8F0", "b3": "#3F86C2", "g1": "#6CC59A", "g2": "#A3E0C0", "g3": "#4BA37A", "y1": "#F7C44E", "y2": "#FFE08A", "y3": "#D9A12E", "p1": "#9B85E0", "p2": "#C2B4F2", "p3": "#7A64C2", "board": "#FFFFFF", "table": "#F2C38C", "table2": "#D19A60", "leaf": "#6DB585", "leaf2": "#A6D99A"}}
